about.body: The N13 is BMW's 1.6-litre turbocharged inline-four petrol engine, co-developed with PSA Peugeot Citroën under the Prince engine programme. It was produced from 2011 to 2016 and fitted to the 1 Series (F20/F21) in 116i and 118i form. It was BMW's entry-level petrol option for the 1 Series during this period, offering a balance of efficiency and performance.

byModel.body: Across the 1 Series (F20/F21, 2011–2016), the N13 powered the 116i and 118i variants as the standard petrol engine option. It was the successor to the N43 engine and was replaced by the B38 engine from 2015 onwards in the 1 Series range.

compatibility.body: Because the N13 was only fitted to a single BMW platform — the F20/F21 1 Series — compatibility is straightforward compared to more widely-deployed engines.
